reviews.text: The kennel is spacious and airy, and the space is very well maintained. The service was always excellent; the staff who interacted with our kitten were outstanding. Every day they gave our kitten attention, and she asked for lots of cuddles and company. It was her first time staying at a hotel, and she seems to have enjoyed it, and everything went well, so it will definitely be our choice in the future!
Very pleasant space for animals. Attentive and caring staff.

A pleasant space for the kittens, which gives me a lot of confidence thanks to the person who welcomes and cares for them, Ms. Laura. She is a very important asset to me, contributing to the smooth running of this space and the proper care of the little animals.

I've been trying to contact Cat Hotel for days and haven't received a response. I've already sent a message on Instagram, left a comment on a photo (which was deleted), sent an email, and haven't gotten a reply. What's going on? I don't understand the treatment.

I couldn't even get your service because apparently you're more interested in posting stories than answering messages or calls, and when I comment on an Instagram post you delete it but don't reply! Imagine what your service must be like!
Great environment for kittens, very attentive staff. Highly recommended.
My kitten has been staying at the hotel since he was 3 months old, and he always comes back happy :)
